name: metis-mcp
description: Registers the Métis MCP server. Provides traceability, coverage and impact analysis, quality/release/test-design reporting, two-stage intake mining that derives Requirements and AcceptanceCriteria from any Episode's raw content, and runtime skill discovery via metis_list_skills. Requires a running Métis server and a ~/.metis/config.json; see metis-server/QUICKSTART.md.
